evidence.evidence_text: New Intent Discovery (NID) aims at detecting known and previously undefined categories of user intent by utilizing limited labeled and massive unlabeled data.

entities.surface: imbalanced new intent discovery i-NID task

evidence.evidence_text: To bridge the gap, our work introduces the imbalanced new intent discovery i-NID task, which seeks to identify familiar and novel intent categories within long-tailed distributions.
A new benchmark baNID-Bench comprised of three datasets is created to simulate the real-world long-tail distributions.
ImbaNID-Bench ranges from broad cross-domain to specific single-domain intent categories, providing a thorough representation of practical use cases.
